A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OAR research work. All 13 pages in each version, including the figures, tables, equations and Appendices A.1–A.3, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original mathematical-reasoning experiments, training dynamics, attribution analyses and ablations in Tables 1–4 and Figures 3–8.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including benchmark evaluations, computational measurements, ablations and appendix visualizations.

M1.justification: The OAR-P perturbation procedure, OAR-G gradient proxy, score normalization, bi-level gating and training objective are unchanged in Sections 3.1–3.3. The added explanatory prose introduces no procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions train on DAPO-MATH and evaluate AIME2024/2025, AMC23, MATH500 and GSM8K. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains GRPO, Random Adv and Entropy Adv for both 7B backbones, with KTAE appearing only in the Qwen2.5-Math-7B block. Table 2 also retains the same comparator set.

E3.justification: The model configurations, Pass@1/Pass@32 metrics, training settings and evaluation procedures are unchanged. This includes group size 8, batch size 64 and the 500-trajectory attribution analysis.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same gating-threshold and outcome-definition ablations, causal-token recall analysis, computational comparison and qualitative case studies. Tables 3–4 and Appendix A.2 introduce no revised analyses.

E5.justification: Statistical and uncertainty reporting is unchanged, including the shaded curves in Figure 5. No run counts, seed information, interval definitions or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 and the result figures retain their values and findings. For example, Table 1 reports Qwen2.5-7B averages of 51.3 for GRPO, 53.2 for OAR-G and 53.7 for OAR-P in both versions. Removing the OAR-G average from Section 4.3's prose does not remove the result from the table.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations are unchanged. Appendix A.1 retains the same reward-aliasing, update-scale, Pinsker-inequality and gradient-noise arguments, while Appendix A.3 retains the same credit-concentration definitions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements and conclusion retain the same claims about outcome-grounded credit assignment, the OAR-P/OAR-G trade-off and improvements over GRPO. Shortening the results narrative does not change these claims.

C2.justification: The added Section 3.3 sentences reiterate explanations already present in v1's introduction and Appendix A.1 concerning update-scale instability and suppression of gradient noise. Interpretations of the experiments and limitations concerning outcome proxies, masking and applicability remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The first-page code pointer changes from Valsure/Outcome-Grounded-Advantage-Reshaping to XINGYUN-AI-LAB/OAR, updating the disclosed access location. Implementation, hyperparameter and hardware details remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish differences in repository contents or availability.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference entries and Section 7's research positioning are unchanged. The new acknowledgements do not introduce related research or alter novelty claims.

P1.justification: v2 revises affiliations, adds acknowledgements and explanatory sentences in Section 3.3, and trims passages in Sections 4.3 and 5.1. These are localized edits within the same overall narrative and section structure.

P2.justification: All eight figures and four tables retain their content and design. v2 removes printed page numbers and adjusts text and table placement: Section 4 begins on PDF page 5 instead of page 4, and Table 3 moves above the Section 6 heading.

improvement.justification: The experimental evidence, mathematical support, core claims and limitations remain unchanged. The added methodological explanation largely repeats reasoning already supplied in v1. The limited prose, affiliation, acknowledgement, code-pointer and layout edits leave the paper's overall quality materially unchanged.
